name: huddol
description: Run your own organization of agents.

scripts.dev:web: pnpm build:web && uv run --project core python -m huddol --web-dir web/dist
scripts.format: pnpm format:config && pnpm format:web && pnpm format:core && pnpm format:rust
scripts.format:check: pnpm format:config:check && pnpm format:web:check && pnpm format:core:check && pnpm format:rust:check
scripts.check: pnpm check:config && pnpm check:web && pnpm check:core && pnpm check:rust
scripts.check:config: tombi lint && actionlint && pnpm exec lefthook validate
scripts.check:web: pnpm exec biome check --formatter-enabled=false . && pnpm --dir web check
scripts.check:core: uv run --directory core ruff check . ../scripts && uv run --directory core mypy src/huddol && uv run --directory core lint-imports
scripts.check:rust: node scripts/cargo.mjs check && node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && pnpm test:core && pnpm test:rust
